1. (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition, wherein the first alarm is triggered at a first location; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor at a second location distinct from the first location, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, wherein the escalated alarm is distinct from the first alarm.

2. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer, and wherein acknowledgment of the second alarm prevents transmission of the output to the physiological monitor.

3. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

4. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm, wherein the escalated alarm has a different frequency than the first alarm.

5. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously in response to detection of the alarm condition.

6. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system, and wherein the central patient management system is configured to receive alarm signals from multiple physiological monitors.

7. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the physiological monitor stores a log of alarm events including timestamps and acknowledgment status.

16. (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition detected by a physiological sensor; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and an escalation status; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data to an operator.

17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system, and wherein the system is configured to communicate with remote devices.

18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm, including whether the alarm has been escalated from an initial state to an escalated state.

19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, including a timestamp of acknowledgment and an identifier of the operator who acknowledged the alarm.

20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices when the alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time interval.
